title: Reopening Calibration — separate challenge thresholds, hysteresis, B_r > C_r, INSUFFICIENT_DATA

source.source_reference: Shawn's explicit teaching, main chat, 2026-10-10. Filed same-evening per his standing law: his word IS the verification (Verification Law); filed immediately, not queued.

intelligence.essence: Not every doubt reopens a settled reading. Challenges have their own thresholds, separate from the original qualification bar, with hysteresis: it takes stronger evidence to reopen than it took to settle, so readings don't flicker with every passing doubt. B_r > C_r: the benefit of reopening must exceed the cost of reopening, estimated before the reopen — re-examination is itself expensive. When the evidence is too thin to decide, the verdict is INSUFFICIENT_DATA, not a quiet default to the old reading or the challenge. Insufficient data is a real answer; it says 'we don't know yet' and stops the system from pretending otherwise.

human_view.meaning: It should be harder to reopen a settled question than to settle it — otherwise everything flickers. And if the evidence is too thin, say 'we don't know' instead of picking a side.
human_view.why_it_matters: Protects the interpretation lifecycle from both thrash (endless reopening) and capture (a weak first reading that can never be challenged).

simple_view.meaning: It should be harder to reopen a settled question than to settle it — otherwise everything flickers. And if the evidence is too thin, say 'we don't know' instead of picking a side.

naya_view.directive: Before reopening, estimate B_r (benefit) and C_r (cost); reopen only if B_r > C_r. Apply the challenge threshold with hysteresis above the original bar. When evidence is thin, record INSUFFICIENT_DATA and stop — never default silently.

ai_view.specification: reopen iff B_r > C_r AND challenge_evidence > challenge_threshold, where challenge_threshold > original_bar (hysteresis). Else if evidence thin: verdict = INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
ai_view.directive: Follow as written. This is law, not guidance.

machine_view.spec_only: Spec-only by design; live KNOW/LAW/ACT wiring parked for the Human Director's word. No production claim.
machine_view.test_evidence: Calibration spec: 24 tests green (separate thresholds, hysteresis, B_r > C_r, INSUFFICIENT_DATA).

intelligence.learning_lesson: Flicker is the observable failure: the same reading reopened and re-settled repeatedly on the same evidence.
decisions: Shawn's word ratifies the teaching. His word IS the verification; no second verification of the lesson itself is permitted (Verification Law).

connections.target: SN-0753 Reopenable interpretation — numeric discipline for its lifecycle.

intelligence.uncertainty: The numeric values of thresholds and the B_r/C_r estimation method are implementer-defined; the law fixes the relations (hysteresis, B_r > C_r, INSUFFICIENT_DATA as terminal verdict).
intelligence.applicability: Every seat that challenges or defends a settled reading.
intelligence.falsifier: Falsified if readings reopen on sub-threshold evidence, or if thin-evidence cases silently default instead of recording INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
intelligence.measurement_contract: Track reopen frequency per reading and the B_r/C_r estimates vs outcomes; calibrate thresholds from the misses.
intelligence.successor_effect: A cold successor with a weak doubt and thin evidence records INSUFFICIENT_DATA instead of relitigating — and a strong challenge with B_r > C_r actually reopens.
